data.subject: NVA and OPAD public-record research
data.body:
Hi,

KMT Wealth Management's most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in NVA and OPAD.

On September 29, 2026, NVA filed a notice of late 10-K filing (NT 10-K) (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1852551/000149315226044708/0001493152-26-044708-index.htm).

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records (permits, agendas, call reports, filings), with every claim cited.

I can send the free weekly issue and offer a four-week fund pilot.

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
